verdict.rationale: Warp has its own benefit-deduction capability: the API can create a benefit deduction for a worker, and its marketing says Warp Agent handles benefits alongside payroll. Nothing in the evidence shows Warp offering health insurance plans or managing enrollments, and there is only a one-line endpoint mention for how deductions sync to payroll. Missing for 10: documented health-insurance plan offering, an employee enrollment workflow, explicit enrollment-to-payroll deduction sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll
